title: Alchemy and Impurities
titles: A Treatise on Alchemy and Toxicity
text:
Balanced elemental scores produce cleaner pills. Missing mandatory requirements ruin a batch. Excess or unrelated elemental Qi increases impurity. A modest neutral base can improve purity and reduce failure; too much becomes waste.

This knowledge lets you estimate purity in the cauldron preview when you also know the recipe. The estimate is a range, not a guarantee of success. Analyze an unfamiliar finished pill in the Bind slot to learn its properties.
